title: City · Glowing cut through buildings
description: In the open city buildings keep their height: when one stands between Gerard and the camera, the part in front of him is cut away and the cut is traced by a glowing edge, instead of the whole block folding down. Interiors still fold their walls.

steps.caption: Out on the avenue nothing is in the way, so every building stands whole
Deep in the passage between two blocks: the block in front opens a glowing cut round Gerard and keeps its height
Deep in the passage between two blocks: the block in front opens a hole round Gerard and keeps its height
Behind the blocks across the avenue: only the glowing cut round Gerard, the rest of the facade and its roof stay
Behind the blocks across the avenue: only the hole, the rest of the facade and its roof stay
